newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Firstar upgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Firstar upgraded to hold.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Tuesday it upgraded Firstar Corp to hold from underweight. The stock was up 1/4 to 53-3/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
- Analyst Ross Demmerle said in a report he raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $4.50 a share from $4.45 and maintained his 1996 estimate of $3.90 versus 1995's $3.27.
- He said his positive 1997 outlook is based on expense reduction.
- In a telephone interview, he said the stock has less downside risk than previously and he expects it to be a market performer.
